motivation: Test one uniformly sampled already-generated unselected candidate before spending on another debug generation.
source_scope: comparison/0912 Qwen Spooky forets-1 seed1 and seed2; already admitted development data
selection: For each seed, executed journal index 1 must be an original selected initial draft; index 2 must be its first direct debug. Include all four unselected initial drafts, without selecting by their outcomes.
prefix_gate: Fresh original-first-draft must fail with the same terminal error as production; otherwise the continuation effect is not identified for that seed.
primary_readout: One recorded first-debug candidate versus a uniform single candidate from the four cached alternatives: valid-output probability and single-program oriented quality, per seed. No best-of-four oracle.
cost_readout: Fresh per-program execution wall seconds reported separately from historical generation latency. For cache-first then original debug on cache failure, derive symbolic generation-latency break-even; not measured live policy speedup.
unit: original physical run, two exploratory units; candidate permutations are not seeds
hardware: gpu28 six RTX3090 GPUs, 36 CPUs, six CPUs per program; original task image unchanged
schedule: seed1 then seed2, six concurrent programs each; start a whole group only with >=7500 seconds remaining after allocation safety allowance
limitations: Cached-program outcomes and prior reports have already been seen; not blinded confirmation
One historical debug generation per seed, not a new sampled generator distribution
Fresh workspace differs from historical Jupyter state
Successful reuse does not establish same-total-resource E2E or novelty
